---
title: "Daniel"
format: html
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)

# Load dataset
scores <- read_csv(file.path("..", "data", "scores.csv"))
player_name <- "daniel"
player_scores <- scores %>% filter(player == player_name) %>% arrange(date)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
tibble(
    Total_Sessions = nrow(player_scores),
    Average_Score = mean(player_scores$score),
    Highest_Score = max(player_scores$score),
    Lowest_Score = min(player_scores$score)
  )
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

ggplot(player_scores, aes(x = date, y = score)) +
    geom_line(group = 1, color = "steelblue") +
    geom_point(color = "darkred", size = 2) +
    labs(title = paste("Scores for", player_name),
         x = "Date", y = "Score") +
    theme_minimal()
```
